documents.title: Documents to Normalize

chunkSize.title: Target Chunk Size (Characters)
chunkSize.description: Maximum target characters per output chunk.

redactPii.title: Redact PII Deterministically
redactPii.description: Mask emails, phone numbers, IPv4 addresses, API tokens, and card-like numbers before LLM ingestion.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate Identical Chunks
deduplicate.description: Drop duplicate chunks across documents using SHA-256 hash of normalized text.
